sentences.text: Author: Rakesh Thapliyal Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal

Office Notes, reports,
 orders or proceedings SL.
 Date or directions and COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORD No  Registrar's order with  Signatures  FA Nos. 33, 34 and 35 of 2023  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
(Through V.C.)
1.
Mr. V.K. Kaparwan, learned counsel for the appellant.
2. Mr. Tarun Mohan and Mr. P.S. Bisht, learned Brief Holders for the State.

3. Mr. V.K. Kohli, learned Sr. Advocate assisted by Mr. Sudhir Kumar and Mr. Tarun Lakhera,
learned counsel for the private respondent.
4.
These three first appeals have been preferred against the order passed by learned District Judge in Reference preferred under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act.
5. According to the learned counsel for the appellant, the rate as determined by the Reference Court are not correct.
6. These appeals are not admitted as yet since the same are time barred.
7. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that before preferring these first appeals, appellant preferred review application but the subsequently the same were returned.

Order passed by the Reference Court has already been stayed subject to deposit of entire decretal amount and in compliance thereof, entire decretal amount has been deposited before the Executing Court.

8. Mr. V.K. Kohli, learned Sr. Advocate for the private respondents submits that the amount towards the compensation, at the rate as admitted to the appellant, in the review application preferred before the learned District Judge may be released.

1 9.
Let counsel for both the parties may calculate the amount of compensation at the rate admitted to the appellant and inform to this Court on the next date.
